response.title: Does a solar generator bundle come with every cable I need to connect the panels, or do I have to buy adapters?
response.answer:
Most solar generator bundles include the cables needed to connect the included solar panels, but not all do. Whether you need additional adapters depends on the brand, model, and bundle configuration.

Here's what you can typically expect:

Component

	

Usually included?




Solar panels

	

Yes, in a solar bundle




Solar panel cables (attached to panels)

	

Usually




Solar charging cable (panel to generator)

	

Often




MC4-to-XT60/XT60i adapter

	

Sometimes




Solar extension cables

	

Usually not




Parallel or series connectors

	

Depends on bundle




AC charging cable

	

Usually

When might you need extra adapters?

EcoFlow: Many models use XT60 or XT60i solar inputs. An MC4-to-XT60i cable may be needed.

Jackery: Many models use proprietary or DC8020 connectors. Adapters may be needed for third-party panels.

BLUETTI: Many models use MC4-compatible solar charging cables, but the generator-side connector varies.

Anker SOLIX: Connector requirements vary by model and panel.

What to check before buying

Whether the bundle explicitly includes a solar charging cable.

Whether the solar panel connectors match the generator's input.

Whether the included cable is long enough for your setup.

Whether connecting multiple panels requires additional branch connectors or adapters.

One important detail: Even when connectors fit, the panels' voltage and current must be within the generator's supported solar input specifications.

Which solar generator bundle are you considering?

Tell me the brand and model (or paste the product link), and I can check exactly which cables come in the box and whether you'll need to purchase any adapters separately.
